resources.string: Let the home screen or the app behind shine through the keyboard

Since Android 14 apps may only read the home screen wallpaper with the permission \"All files access\". Grant it to GlassType so the wallpaper can shine through exactly. Without it, choose your wallpaper image manually via \"Set background image\" – it will be aligned to the screen the same way.
Uses the speech recognition of your phone directly in the keyboard. Live text while speaking, no plugin needed.
